feed_composition.description: Wet-mass fractions for canonical GreenHub compound IDs only. If omitted or empty, the canonical GreenHub feed profile is applied. Supplied totals from 0.90 to 1.10 are normalized to 1.00 by the request contract.

storage_conditions.description: Opt-in component retention or source-gated grass reaction package; see decision-support options.

get.description: Returns PR7 membrane-screening options. The screen uses clarified grass juice with no 14-day pre-membrane fermentation/storage; any downstream digestion remains controlled by the separate AD scenario. TUF/LNF co-retention inputs and MEUF gaps are separately identified.

post.description: Calculates provisional analyte capture, membrane area, and gross revenue. Choose either empirical flux or the resistance model; conflicting flux methods are rejected. TUF free-state retention uses the sigma/Peclet relation at selected flux; supplied bound-pool factors remain empirical, and LNF film predictions are diagnostic. If component flows are supplied, the isolated BioSTEAM unit runs and conserves pools without documented retentions at a separate unresolved outlet. This is not a full plant simulation; unresolved pools gate complete product allocation, TEA and LCA.

cip_solution_volume_L_per_step.description: Optional working-solution volume for each sequential CIP reagent step; requires make-up fraction and evidence note.

component_flows_kg_hr.description: Optional actual feed component flows in kg/hour. Pools without a documented class retention are conserved in unresolved_kg_hr rather than assigned a guessed fraction.

component_flows_source.description: Required source/evidence note for caller-supplied component_flows_kg_hr; not required when flows are loaded from run_id.

component_retention_override_sources.description: Required source/evidence note matching each explicit retention override.

component_retention_overrides.description: Explicit per-component retention fractions; each key must also appear in component_retention_override_sources.

concentration_factor.description: Retentate concentration factor; default is the user-supplied value in the PR7 parameter register.

include_cip_screening_lca.description: Explicitly apply registered attributional upstream NaOH and citric-acid production factors to CIP chemical inventory; excludes cleaning wastewater and utilities.

operational_input_sources.description: Required source note for every supplied annual activity, emission factor, or energy price. Use explicit zero activity with a source note when the utility is not used.

price_EUR_L.description: Screening bulk-concentrate price; default is the user-supplied nominal value in the PR7 parameter register.

pump_efficiency_fraction.description: Caller-supplied pump efficiency for the pressure-work estimate; no default is assumed.

resistance_flux_model.description: Resistance-equation flux method for TUF/LNF. Select this or empirical flux_L_m2_h, not both.

viscosity_Pa_s.description: Measured clarified-juice viscosity for the no-fermentation feed; fermented-juice viscosity is not reused.

run_id.description: Optional completed model run; uses its clarified-protein-rich-liquid component flows for the co-retention split.

transmembrane_pressure_bar.description: Optional pressure-work estimate input; requires pump_efficiency_fraction and matching evidence notes.

maximum_membrane_area_m2.description: Upper membrane-area screen (m²), null while any component fate remains unresolved.

membrane_area_m2.description: Point estimate is null when unresolved outlet mass is nonzero.

minimum_membrane_area_m2.description: Known-permeate membrane-area floor (m²); unresolved pools are excluded.

unresolved_kg_year.description: Unresolved outlet mass over supplied operating hours (kg/year).

film_retention_diagnostics.description: TUF free-state sigma/Peclet retention is applied at selected flux; LNF free-state predictions are diagnostic beside empirical screen factors. Bound predictions are null until bound-payload diffusivity is supplied.

weighted_state_retention_fraction.description: Free/bound weighted process retention using the state-specific basis reported below.

logistics_result.description: Optional precomputed logistics result forwarded to TEA and LCA; it does not alter process chemistry or balances.

use_screening_lca_factors.description: Explicitly opt in to traceable Netherlands electricity and heat factors plus PR7 CIP reagent production factors; these are screening values and project-specific factors should replace them.

use_screening_process_assumptions.description: Explicitly opt in to the traceable screening process-assumption profile.
